_comment: Authoritative list of which Iridium satellites are active mission satellites
and which are in-orbit spares, broken down by orbital plane.
Numbers are Iridium vehicle numbers, i.e. the NNN in the CelesTrak name
This file is the only thing that decides operational vs spare. A satellite
missing from it is treated as operational, so a newly launched one shows up
as a normal member of the constellation until you add it here.
data/satellite-overrides.json still wins over this file.
Plane numbering follows this list, not orbital geometry.
